quarterly_data.quarter: TTM Technologies press release: TTM Technologies, Inc. Continues Global Growth Strategy (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TTM entered into a definitive agreement (announced August 17, 2026) to acquire EPIQ Design Solutions LLC (Epiq), which the release describes as a provider of open-architecture, AI-enabled software-defined radios (SDRs), high-performance RF products and radiation-tolerant space compute solutions supporting signals intelligence and electronic warfare applications. TTM says the acquisition is projected to elevate its vertical integration capabilities for its integrated electronics products, and it believes the deal significantly expands its addressable opportunities in defense mission areas including Missile Defense, GEO-to-LEO Space, Communications and Signals Intelligence, Electronic Warfare, and Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance. CEO Edwin Roks: the addition of Epiq 'is highly strategic and provides complementary technology to our overall portfolio and represents an important step in executing our long-term growth strategy.'
